intro: Estonia has only about 1.4 million people. Estonian is closely related to Finnish, and singing is at the heart of the national identity.

chapters.title: People and language
text: Tallinn, with its medieval old town, is the capital. Estonian is a Finnic language, unlike the Baltic languages of Latvia and Lithuania. About a quarter of people are Russian speakers, many living in the north-east around Narva.
Estonia is one of the least religious countries in the world. Every five years around 30,000 singers perform together at the Song Festival in Tallinn.

chapters.title: Digital life
text: Estonians can do almost everything online, from filing taxes in minutes to voting, using a digital ID card. Children learn programming at school.

keyTerms.meaning: A group of languages including Finnish and Estonian.
